status: frozen after the immutable V19J formal pass and required post-hash topology failure but before re-reading a science array for V19K, selecting a V19K seed, extracting a science profile, evaluating a continuous or discontinuous science likelihood, linking a V19K arc, fitting a final front profile, running a front bootstrap, constructing a spectrum, opening a lensing target, or selecting a gravity formula
purpose: Correct the single audited V19J failure class by requiring an automatically seeded brightness discontinuity to improve exact Poisson likelihood over a continuous local profile with both gradient and curvature, while preserving every V19H scientific threshold and using no published front coordinate or hand sector.

complete_prefilter.input: every true pixel in the immutable V19J nonmaximum_candidate array, with its immutable best scale, best signed faint-to-bright normal and best two-sided score
complete_prefilter.seed_rule: within the complete candidate mask, retain a best-score local maximum in a Euclidean disk of radius 10 kpc; exact score plateaus retain only the lexicographically first row then column

profile_extraction.normal_coordinate: t=(x-x_seed) dot n, positive from the V19J fainter side toward the brighter side
profile_extraction.pixel_assignment: assign a frozen native pixel by its center to exactly one half-open normal bin when abs(s)<=75 kpc and -200<=t<200 kpc
profile_extraction.per_bin_data: sum integer soft counts C, frozen scaled background B, background variance V_B, exposure E, valid pixel count and total geometric pixel count
profile_extraction.failure_rule: discard the seed without filling, shifting, widening, rotating or merging profile bins

poisson_models.discontinuous_alternative: S1_j=exp(a+b tau_j+c tau_j^2+d H(t_j-delta)), with d nonnegative and the positive-t side defined as brighter
poisson_models.density_compression: C_density=exp(d/2), capped at the gamma=5/3 hydrodynamic limit four only through the frozen d bound
poisson_models.optimizer: L-BFGS-B with analytic log-likelihood and gradient, maximum 500 iterations and ftol 1e-12; initialize a from the total positive net rate and b=c=0; initialize each alternative from the null with d=ln(4); if and only if nonfinite or unsuccessful, run bounded Powell then one L-BFGS-B polish
poisson_models.step_grid_selection: largest finite alternative likelihood; exact ties choose smaller abs(delta), then smaller signed delta

arc_linking.nodes: only profile-valid seeds with Z_step at least five
arc_linking.tangent_alignment: the node-to-node vector must lie within 30 degrees of the local tangent at both nodes
arc_linking.components: undirected connected components under all three fixed edge rules
arc_linking.circle_fit: unweighted algebraic circle fit to every node in the component; reject rank-deficient fits
arc_linking.arc_length: radius times the smallest circular angular span containing every component node, obtained by removing the largest cyclic angular gap
arc_linking.component_score: sum DeltaC across all component nodes, used only for automatic ranking
arc_linking.primary_rule: largest component score; exact ties choose longer arc then lexicographic representative x/y
arc_linking.representative_position_and_normal: DeltaC-weighted circular/linear means over every node; no node may be discarded after component formation

mandatory_pre_science_fixtures.linear_gradient: zero retained arcs even at the science-map peak count scale
mandatory_pre_science_fixtures.smooth_radial_beta_profile: zero retained arcs for a curved centrally concentrated profile with no discontinuity
mandatory_pre_science_fixtures.curved_compression_two_step: at least one retained arc with fitted density compression central value between 1.5 and 2.5 and median node distance no more than 16 kpc from the injected circle
mandatory_pre_science_fixtures.masked_step: zero retained arcs when the inherited 90-percent profile-validity gate fails
mandatory_pre_science_fixtures.failure_rule: do not execute on either science cluster if any fixture fails; do not change a model, optimizer, seed, scale, bin, score or arc threshold in response to the science maps

science_gates.required_post_hash_visual_audit: a retained arc must be a sparse simple ridge rather than a contour forest, chip edge, point-source residual or branched network; an audit failure preserves the machine report and triggers a new protocol rather than an in-place threshold change
science_gates.advance_only_if_both_clusters_pass: run the inherited projected broken-power-law profile fit and exactly 1000 parametric bootstraps on every retained arc before any spectra or shock claim
